welcome.title: Welcome to Aurum
welcome.body: Let's take a quick tour so you know your way around. You can skip or close this at any time.

stats.title: Your finances at a glance
stats.body: These four cards show your weekly activity, total balance, debt, and net worth — all updated in real time.

recentTransactions.title: Recent transactions
recentTransactions.body: Your latest activity lives here. Click the card to see the full ledger and add new transactions.

challenges.title: Challenges keep you on track
challenges.body: Set time-boxed goals like saving, paying down debt, or curbing a spending category. Progress shows up here.

budgets.title: Annual budgets
budgets.body: Plan the full year across 12 months. Compare planned vs actual spending and spot over- and underspending instantly.

navigation.title: Explore the rest of the app
navigation.body: Use the sidebar to jump to accounts, transactions, assets, debts, and income planning.

familySwitcher.title: Switch between families
familySwitcher.body: Part of more than one family? Switch between them here — or create a new one.

settings.title: Settings live here
settings.body: Click your name to change language and theme, or manage family members.

meta.title: Aurum — Family finance, in one place
meta.description: Aurum brings the family's finances together. Accounts, budgets, savings and net worth — in one place.

hero.subhead: Aurum makes it simple to keep track of the household together. Accounts, budgets, savings and net worth — without bank connections or fuss.

features.heading: How you'll use Aurum.
features.lead: Five tools that work together — everything you need, in one place.

budget.headline: A whole year, laid out across twelve months.
budget.body: Set the budget for the whole year. Aurum spreads it across the months — monthly, quarterly, semi-annual or annual. The current month always stays in focus.

family.headline: The whole family, the same numbers.
family.body: Invite your partner or the rest of the household. You all see the same numbers and make decisions together.

transactions.headline: Keep track of entries.
transactions.body: Import via CSV or enter manually. Aurum suggests categories based on your earlier entries.

challenges.headline: Set small goals along the way.
challenges.body: Set a limit for a week or a month. Aurum keeps an eye on how far you've gone and lets you know if you're getting close.

networth.headline: See your full picture.
networth.body: Accounts plus assets minus debts. Aurum brings the numbers together and shows the trend month by month.

pricing.heading: Pricing that's easy to understand.
pricing.lead: Pick the plan that fits you. Switch any time.

items.q: How do you protect my data?
items.a: Aurum is hosted in the EU and only uses GDPR-compliant tooling. Your data never leaves the continent.
Danish kroner in this release. More currencies are on the way.
The Personal plan is free forever. Family can be tried without commitment.

items.q: How many family members can I invite?
items.a: No limit on the Family plan. Personal is just for you.
With a one-time code by email. No passwords to remember or lose.
Yes. Monthly billing. Cancel from settings, and your data stays with you.
Danish and English. Language follows your profile — not your browser.
